pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Pass-through entity tax at 6.99% (Form CT-PET). Mandatory for 2018-2023, optional (elective) from 2024; the 2025 form is labeled 'Optional Pass-Through Entity Tax Return'. 2026 form not yet published.

sources.title: Form CT-PET Connecticut Pass-Through Entity Tax Return 2025
sources.quote: PE Tax due: Multiply Line 1 by 6.99% (.0699).

personal_exemption.notes: Exemption is reduced $1,000 for each $1,000 of Connecticut AGI over $30,000 (single) / $48,000 (joint), so it disappears at $45,000 / $72,000. A separate personal tax credit (75% down to 0%) applies at low incomes. Not indexed (statute fixed since 2016).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: Benefit recapture: the 2% bracket is phased out for single filers with CT AGI over $56,500 (joint thresholds double), plus recapture add-ons above $105,000, $200,000 and $500,000 of CT AGI (single), which effectively tax all income at the top marginal rate for high earners (CGS 12-700(a)(10)).

sources.title: CGS Chapter 229, Sec. 12-700(a)(10) (taxable years on or after January 1, 2024)
sources.quote: Over $500,000 $31,250, plus 6.99% of the excess over $500,000

sources.title: CGS Sec. 12-702 Exemptions
sources.quote: For taxable years commencing on or after January 1, 2016, fifteen thousand dollars.

sources.title: OLR Comparison of State Income Taxes (2026-R-0057)

estimated_tax.required_if: No underpayment interest if tax shown on the return less Connecticut withholding is under $1,000
estimated_tax.notes: Underpayment interest 1% per month. Farmers/fishermen: one installment January 15. Filing and paying in full by January 31 waives the fourth installment.

unemployment_2026.notes: 2026 wage base up from $26,100; new employer rate down from 2.2% to 1.9%. Contribution rates 1.1%-9.9% including the fund solvency tax.

notable: No LLC franchise or business entity tax (the $250 BET was repealed from 2020); only the $80 annual report (https://business.ct.gov/knowledge-base/articles/domestic-annual-report-forms-and-fees)
Connecticut recaptures the low brackets for higher incomes, so the effective top rate applies to all income for high earners (https://www.cga.ct.gov/2025/pub/chap_229.htm)
PTE tax became optional from 2024 at 6.99% (https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/drs/forms/2025/pass-through/ct-pet_1225.pdf)
uncertain: Brackets are fixed in statute (12-700(a)(10), single and joint schedules both read) and not indexed; no 2026 rate change found.
Annual report due window (Jan 1 - Mar 31) and late penalty not re-read on an official page today.
Connecticut Paid Leave employee contribution (0.5%) not verified for 2026.
